threads.title: Inbound call, Tanya Brooks (calls to Jamaica)

exchanges.author: c_tanya
exchanges.body: Hi, it's Tanya Brooks, I left a message this morning. I have thirty-eight dollars of calls to Jamaica on my bill.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Hi Tanya, thanks for calling back. Can I have your PIN so I can open the account?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Thanks, you're verified. I see three calls in October to two numbers starting with 876, for sixty-four minutes. Do you remember calling them?

exchanges.author: c_tanya
exchanges.body: I got missed calls from those numbers, it rang once and stopped. I thought 876 was a US area code, so I called back and got hold music for ages.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: That sounds like a one-ring scam. 876 is Jamaica, even though it looks like a US number, and those calls are billed as international. Please don't call back numbers like that. I can't take the full amount off myself, so I'm sending it to our billing team today to review a credit for the thirty-eight forty; they'll contact you within one business day.

exchanges.author: c_tanya
exchanges.body: OK. Can you stop it happening again?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Yes. I can add a free block on international and Caribbean calls from your Home Phone; it stops calls to 876 and similar codes. Should I turn it on?

exchanges.author: c_tanya
exchanges.body: Yes please.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: It's on now. You can still call anywhere in the US and Canada.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Reason: $38.40 of calls to Jamaica (+1-876-555-0182 10/12 and 10/13, +1-876-555-0139 10/17; 64 min at $0.60). Verified by PIN. Customer returned one-ring missed calls; likely one-ring scam. Tier 1 authority left $25.00 (goodwill $15.00 on 10/20), so sent to Tier 2 Billing for review of a $38.40 credit; customer told 1 business day. Added the free International and Caribbean call block at her request.
